problem_statement: The file system core rejects a stat request for the root directory. Calling fs_stat() with the root path "/" returns an error instead of succeeding, even though fs_opendir() already accepts the root directory. fs_stat() should accept the root path, report it as a directory entry with the name "/" and zero size, and return success.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/subsys/fs/fs_api -s tests/subsys/fs/fs_api/filesystem.api -s filesystem.api -O twister-out --no-clean -W
